# transcription of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:transcriptionOf`](gmeow-transcriptionOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/transcriptionOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A flat shortcut asserting that a creative work is a transcription derived from another creative work. The reified form is a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) with [`gmeow:derivationType`](gmeow-derivationType.md) [`gmeow:derivationTypeTranscription`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeTranscription.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:transcriptionOf`](gmeow-transcriptionOf.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md), [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case of asserting one work transcribes another into a different notation system or medium, when no further metadata is needed.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the transcription's source segments, notation system, or provenance must be first-class — promote to a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) with [`gmeow:derivationTypeTranscription`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeTranscription.md).

### How to use

- Assert from the transcription to the source; it [`pairsWith`](gmeow-pairsWith.md) [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) — promote when metadata is required.

### Examples

- ex:guitarTab [`gmeow:transcriptionOf`](gmeow-transcriptionOf.md) ex:liveRecording.
